title: Public Alert No. 014/2026 -Alert on Confirmed Counterfeits PHESGO 600mg With Batch Numbers B2346B16 and C3809C5
summary: NAFDAC alerts on confirmed counterfeit Phesgo 600mg/600mg/10mL (pertuzumab/trastuzumab) with batch numbers B2346B16 and C3809C5, reported from LUTH and confirmed falsified by Roche. Fake batch numbers, wrong GTIN, missing tamper-evidence label and packaging differences.
